## Summary

## Canon status

State whether the work is a technical placeholder, provisional design, approved canon implementation, or mixed. Identify any conflict or dependency involving the newest Diyse Active Master Canon.

`docs/maps/..._Design_Sheet.md`

For non-map work, write `Not applicable`.

## Standard sections

## Tested requirements

List automated tests, complete-route coverage, regression checks, Android compilation, certificate verification, and device-acceptance targets as applicable.

## Deferred

List relevant art, canon, audio, encounter, accessibility, persistence, optimization, or follow-up work intentionally postponed. Write `None` only when genuinely complete.
